items.text: Estrutura de pacotes com.neuroassist.dash api, application, domain, infrastructure
Dependencias Spring Boot Web, Actuator, OAuth2 Resource Server, Eureka Client, Feign declaradas em `backend/services/dash-service/build.gradle.kts`. Sem JPA, sem datasource, sem Flyway.
Configuracao em `backend/services/dash-service/src/main/resources/application.yml` com server.port=8090, Eureka, JWK-set-uri, timeouts e URLs dos upstreams.
Gradle :services:dash-service:build passa sem erros (BUILD SUCCESSFUL verificado)
/actuator/health retorna 200 UP com Eureka em modo prefer-ip-address
Nenhuma dependencia spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, flyway-core ou spring-datasource no classpath (ADR-004 compliant)
Pacote root com.neuroassist.dash com subpacotes api, application, domain, infrastructure presentes e compilando
Variaveis de ambiente documentadas em `backend/services/dash-service/src/main/resources/application.yml` com ${ENV_VAR:default}
